title: Mountains Scene 9 — Mountain Spatial Clues
purpose: Complex spatial clues and multi-step listening using alpine animals and landmarks.

sentenceModels: The eagle is above the mountains.
The goat is on the high rock.
The marmot is below the goat.
The bridge is over the stream.

adultSupport.focus: Use two-part spatial clues and compare high/low positions.
expansionPrompts: First point to the goat, then point to the marmot.
Find the animal below the high rock and near the water.

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 2 automatic pass against the visible teaching targets.
